❌ Unguarded RTCP XR: 65,535s RTT Wrap & Spoofed MOS Failover
1. Compact-NTP 32-Bit Unsigned RTT Underflow (65,535s NACK Freeze)
• RTT = A - LSR - DLSR in 1/65536s compact-NTP ticks.
• 1ms local NTP step-back or inflated DLSR causes A < LSR + DLSR.
• Unsigned uint32 subtraction underflows -66 ticks to 65,535,999 ms!
• Trips RTT > 500ms gate → permanently disables RTCP NACK recovery!
Result: 6.55×10⁷x RTT Explosion & Frozen Packet-Loss Recovery
2. RFC 3611 BT=7 VoIP Metrics Spoofed MOS & Gmin=0 Distortion
• Rogue/buggy peer sends BT=7 with R-Factor=15, MOS-LQ=1.2 & Gmin=0
even though local RTP sequence numbers show 0% loss & 3ms jitter.
• Unguarded SLA router trusts remote MOS blindly, triggering false
carrier trunk failovers & Markov burst-density division-by-zero!
Result: False Trunk Failover Storms & Corrupted QoE SLA Telemetry
✅ Signed DLRR RTT Guard (P905) & BT=7 Cross-Check Guard (P906 🎉)
P905 · RFC 3611 DLRR Signed int32 Diff & [1, 3000]ms RTT Guard
• Computes A - LSR - DLSR using signed 32-bit modular arithmetic.
• Rejects negative clock-skew underflows & spoofed DLSR inflation.
• Clamps validated media RTT to [1, 3000]ms so EWMA RTT stays clean
and RTCP NACK retransmission stays 100% responsive!
clampedRttUnderflowWrapOrOutlierSamples = 0 · RTT ∈ [1, 3000]ms
P906 (🎉 915th Guard!) · BT=7 MOS Cross-Validation & Gmin [16, 64] Guard
• Cross-validates inbound BT=7 MOS-LQ/R-Factor against local RTP
sequence-number loss and interarrival jitter before acting.
• Quarantines uncorroborated MOS drops & clamps Markov burst-gap
threshold Gmin to [16, 64] packets (16 nominal per RFC 3611)!
clampedSpoofedMosFailoversOrInvalidGminBlocks = 0 · Gmin ∈ [16, 64]
